label: Late-episode D1 after no reward, while the agent favours a2 and value is low
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), and only in the last ~20 trials of an episode (trial >= 80, about 90% of mass in trials 90-99). Almost every activation comes when the policy already leans toward a2 (logit(a1)-logit(a2) < -1.5; upcoming action is a2 in 99.9% of cases) and the value head is in its lowest bin (< 5.22, 98% of mass). Firing is strongest after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0 holds 74% of mass), but rewarded D1s also fire at lower rates. It is 38x enriched on D1 fixation errors. It does not fire before trial 80, at GO/D2, or when the agent leans toward a1. Without the prev_reward term the predicate keeps 96% of mass at precision 0.25; with it, F1 is about 0.61 on dev. All variables used are observed or the model's own outputs, and no future variables are needed. Precision stays incomplete: many late-episode, a2-leaning, low-value D1 steps stay silent, so an unidentified factor (perhaps the time-in-episode signal itself) gates it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+5.12), phase=D1 & last=a2 S1 r (+4.85), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (+4.62), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 2 (9 = most a1) (+4.38), phase=D1 & ep_dec=9 (+3.80), phase=D1 & ep_dec=8 (+3.02). Lower it: prev_state=2 (-3.74), prev_common=1 (-3.39), choice_bin=decile 6 (9 = most a1) (-2.55), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 6 (9 = most a1) (-2.53).
